scope: The currently selected accepted DM or current-member group DM can supply a bounded text-only overlay projection from already-loaded messages. No history fetch or read receipt is introduced.

DM and group caches carry account and credential-generation provenance and reset synchronously across authentication boundaries. Encrypted conversations require ready crypto; undecrypted content, spoilers, blocked and ignored authors, and filtered spam are excluded.

Open/compose grants bind conversation type as well as identifier, owner and generation, preventing a same-ID switch between DM and group from reusing a grant. Native children still receive only bounded labels/text and opaque grants, not cryptographic material or history objects.

Explicit sends use existing DM/group encrypted store paths with captured owner/generation and a live caller predicate. Scoped group sends cannot adopt or retry an older pending operation, preserving the main composer draft. Installing the new send's pending operation does not revoke its own authorization.
